$Comment: What a player hears as they open a reward chest: one sound, picked by the rarest reward in it.
This is the library's own neutral default; a mod's same-named file or the owner layer
The moment fires once each time the chest's page opens, never again while it stays open, and
carries 'rarity': the rarest reward's rarity as its drop's chance reads it (Common, Uncommon,
Rare, Epic or Legendary). A chest whose rewards carry no chance carries no rarity, and plays
the Sound above the Variants, as Common and Uncommon do. 'player' is who opened it.
